outcome: Postpartum pain (location, quality, timing, visual analog scale (VAS) scores)
cohort: 59 postpartum patients experiencing pain were recruited at St Barnabas Hospital in Bronx, New York.
finding: Osteopathic manipulative treatment (OMT) significantly reduced postpartum pain, with mean VAS scores decreasing from 5.0 before OMT to 2.9 after OMT.
mod_finding: VAS pain scores before OMT significantly differed between patients who had a vaginal delivery and those who had a cesarean delivery, but the mean decrease in VAS score after OMT was similar in both groups.
